facts.text: Lander University was founded as Williamston Female College in Williamston, South Carolina, in 1872 by Methodist clergyman Samuel Lander.

sources.title: History - Lander University
sources.quote: Lander University was founded as a college for women by Methodist clergyman Samuel Lander in 1872, as Williamston Female College in Williamston, South Carolina.

facts.text: Lander became the only four-year liberal arts college in the United States to be controlled and financed by a county government.

sources.title: History - Lander University
sources.quote: Lander thus became the only four-year liberal arts college in the United States to be controlled and financed by a county government.

facts.text: Lander University was the first South Carolina university to freeze tuition in 2016, reaching a streak of ten consecutive years of frozen tuition.

sources.title: Lander University Freezes Tuition for Tenth Year in a Row
sources.quote: The freeze will mark ten years the University has frozen tuition. Lander University was the first South Carolina university to freeze tuition in 2016.
